scripts.build: rm -rf dist/sw.js dist/offline-size.json dist/web.html dist/web.js dist/web.js.map dist/maplibre-worker.mjs dist/maplibre-gl.css dist/world-110m.json dist/chunks dist/excalidraw dist/harness.js dist/harness.js.map dist/harness.html dist/*.test-bundle.mjs && esbuild src/main.ts src/web.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --splitting --outdir=dist --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --sourcemap && mkdir -p dist/excalidraw && cp node_modules/@excalidraw/excalidraw/dist/prod/index.css dist/excalidraw/ && cp -R node_modules/@excalidraw/excalidraw/dist/prod/fonts dist/excalidraw/fonts && node build-index.mjs dist/index.html && node build-index.mjs --web dist/web.html && cp web-assets/* dist/ && node css/bundle.mjs dist/style.css && mkdir -p dist/fonts && cp fonts/*.woff2 dist/fonts/ && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs dist/ && rm -rf dist/cmaps dist/standard_fonts && cp -R node_modules/pdfjs-dist/cmaps dist/cmaps && cp -R node_modules/pdfjs-dist/standard_fonts dist/standard_fonts && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/web/pdf_viewer.css dist/ && rm -rf dist/images && cp -R node_modules/pdfjs-dist/web/images dist/images && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css dist/ && rm -rf dist/fonts/katex && mkdir -p dist/fonts && cp -R node_modules/katex/dist/fonts/. dist/fonts/ && esbuild node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs --bundle --minify --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/maplibre-worker.mjs --log-level=warning && cp node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css dist/ && cp node_modules/world-atlas/countries-110m.json dist/world-110m.json && node build-sw.mjs && node build-web.mjs
